description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class AbstractFormProcessor within the namespace Goteo\Library\Forms. The class implements form processing logic, such as creating forms, managing form options, handling models, validations, and saving form data. It serves as a base class for specific form processors in the Goteo project.

classes.name: AbstractFormProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common form processing functionalities such as creating forms, setting options, validation, and saving data. Implements FormProcessorInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form processor with a form builder, model, and optional settings.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: To be implemented by subclasses to add form fields; returns the current object.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default form data, optionally sanitized.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the form object, creating and optionally submitting it if errors are to be shown.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Associates a data model with the form processor.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the form to readonly mode.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Checks if the form is readonly.

methods.name: setFullValidation
methods.description: Enables or disables full validation and sets whether to show errors.

methods.name: getFullValidation
methods.description: Checks if full validation is enabled.

methods.name: showErrors
methods.description: Returns whether errors should be shown.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets options for the form processor.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value by key.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data to the model, throws exceptions on errors.

methods.name: processImageChange
methods.description: Handles updates to image data within the form, managing removal or uploads.
